summary.content:
Today's selection covers 97 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 62 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Musk accuses Altman of stealing a charity as courtroom battle begins
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, The Verge, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 66 articles published in the last 24 hours
